trace: submit -> descriptors 0/1/2 -> avail head 0 -> port notify
DMA request page header[0..16], data[16..528], status[528]
poll used.idx -> exact next index/head -> fence -> status -> read copy
features: all offered low 32 bits except RO and SCSI accepted; FLUSH remembered, RO separately remembered; no explicit implemented-feature allowlist

flush.submitted: type 4, sector 0, two descriptors header+status; no data descriptor
flush.completion: used ring plus status==OK; false propagates as Io; unsupported capability becomes Unsupported in KernelBlkDev/VirtioBootDisk
flush.ordering: one outstanding request, caller serializes; cache writes dirty slots before inner flush

interrupts: no block ISR completion path; synchronous polling is authoritative; interrupts not required for used-ring progress
reset: initial write of status 0, immediately ACK|DRIVER; no reset completion readback or runtime reset
queue_findings: qsize only checked nonzero; fixed 16384-byte allocation can be too small
no persistent media GET_ID or config-generation query
capacity low/high read is not a stable repeated legacy snapshot
status IOERR/UNSUPP/0xff collapse to bool false
completion_repair: poison on timeout/unsolicited used index/malformed index or head; no post-timeout reuse
transport_scope: legacy PCI, coherent x86_64 HHDM/PMM; no modern/MMIO/IOMMU qualification
